name: ClientDeliverableAcceptanceTracker
tagline: Review rounds, client sign-off and revision limits for every deliverable – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete deliverable acceptance app for professional services firms: submit versions for client review, record feedback, track review rounds against the SOW revision limit, require a change order for extra rounds, collect sign-off against acceptance criteria, apply deemed acceptance and see which fees are ready to invoice. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Review rounds vs included rounds with change-order rule
Client review period (business days) with due-soon and overdue flags
Accepted with comments, rejection and withdrawal reasons
Bulk reminders, status moves and owner assignment with undo
Phone layout with bottom view bar, lane picker and agenda calendar
Power Fx outputs and six events
